english: It's a legendary battle arena in the Colosseum Zone! They say a portal only appears in peaceful Zones, but it never appeared in Elestou Zone... Now that you brought peace here, the portal has opened!

blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: You battle the heroes who saved the Digital World! It's ranked, so you can test your strength. Raise your rank and earn a title and prizes! Those prizes are only available there! I can't wait! Let's go!

english: Welcome to the DigiColosseum!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: This is the DigiColosseum...?
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: Yes, indeed! This is the DigiColosseum! A historic arena etched with countless battles! It has always stood at the heart of the Digital World, transcending time and space... This is the legendary DigiColosseum!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: ...It's that amazing? I had no idea...
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: The DigiColosseum was born with the Digital World, and some say it will perish with it. In a sense, the DigiColosseum is the Digital World itself. Only chosen Digimon may enter!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: ...Huh?! But, as you can see, I'm not a Digimon...
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: You're here to support Digimon in battle, aren't you? Team leaders, Tamers, Breeders, Generals... Whatever you call yourselves, you're very welcome here!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: I get that this place has a great history, but what are my Digimon and I supposed to do here?
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: This is a battle arena for Digimon who have mastered their skills. Form a team and test your strength against others!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: First, talk to Minomon at the counter. It will recommend a tournament for your rank. Just enter that tournament and you're ready to go!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: Do I need anything to enter? I don't have much money...
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: All you need is strength and skill you've trained, plus the courage and friendship you've built with your partner. No special qualifications,and no money,are needed!

english: I see...
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: After you enter, talk to Knightmon. Then you can pass through the portal in the back. As a challenger, you'll enter the battle arena and fight the great Masters! Win against the team led by each rank's Master, and your entry rank will rise one step at a time!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: If you beat the top-ranked Legend Master, you'll become a new Legend Master yourself! Whoa, that's so coooool!▼
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: Once you actually enter, though, you'll see that it's more like a dream than reality. Take it one step at a time.

english: Hello! This is the DWM Tournament Entry Counter, where we measure each Digimon's strength!♪

blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: DWM stands for Digital World Master! It's a measure of Digimon battle strength! There are five Master ranks: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Legend! Fight the Masters in a tournament, and if you win, you'll be recognized as a Master of that rank! Get it?♪
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum lore, entry and rank logic, and the first four tournament reward tiers. Equipment names follow the existing reviewed item glossary.

english: The peace of the Digital World rests on your shoulders! Woo-hoo! So cool! I'm falling for you!▼

english: This is the DigiColosseum, the heart of the Digital World! A place that selects and tests those with the strength to shape its future! I know everything about anyone strong enough to make it here: your name, face, personality, partner, hobbies, skills, habits, how you sleep, what you like and hate... Everything!
